display.purpose: The page's single giant headline; lowercase, steps down as content grows.

label.purpose: Uppercase 13px chips on 2px-bordered sticker backgrounds, rotated -1deg.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrance and hover transitions; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Recipe Tile
components.description: The square unit of the shelf — flat ingredient color or a full-bleed photo with a cream title sticker.
components.html: aug 12miso butter pasta
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: block; width: 148px; height: 148px; background: #ff4b26; color: #16130e; border: 2px solid #16130e; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 #16130e; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 0 #16130e; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b3df5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile-caption { position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-tile-title { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 10px; left: 12px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Group Sticker
components.description: The rotated basil label chip that names each shelf group.
components.css: .ds-sticker { display: inline-block; background: #2fa84f; color: #16130e; border: 2px solid #16130e; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-1deg); }

components.name: Add Tile
components.description: Dashed placeholder tile — 'not real yet' — expands inline into a form.
components.css: .ds-add-tile { width: 148px; height: 148px; background: transparent; color: #16130e; border: 2px dashed #16130e; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-add-tile:hover { background: #fffdf8; } .ds-add-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b3df5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Basil save/confirm action with resting cast-iron shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2fa84f; color: #16130e; border: 2px solid #16130e; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 #16130e; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 0 #16130e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b3df5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sharp-cornered paper field with cast-iron border; focus shifts, never glows.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fdf6ec; color: #16130e; border: 2px solid #16130e; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input::placeholder { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b3df5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Nav Item
components.description: Left-rail square icon tile; active state is a yolk sticker.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 2px solid transparent; color: #16130e; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { border-color: #16130e; background: #fffdf8; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 #16130e; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-color: #16130e; background: #ffc21c; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 #16130e; }

narrative.overview: dutch-oven looks like a kitchen wall, not a dashboard: butcher-paper ground, cast-iron ink outlines, and tiles in the colors of ingredients — tomato, yolk, basil, eggplant. Everything is flat, square, and unapologetically bold. Labels are stickers: extrabold uppercase chips slapped on at a slight rotate. Rejected worlds: metro tiles on pure black, pantry-shelf, diner ticket-rail.
keyCharacteristics: Butcher-paper cream ground, never white, never dark
Cast-iron ink 2px borders on every surface; zero radius, zero gradients
Hard offset shadows only — no blur, no glow
Ingredient brights carry meaning; black text on tomato/yolk/basil, white on eggplant
Stickers and dashed outline tiles for anything not yet real

rules.name: The Ingredient Rule
rules.body: Color comes from the kitchen, not a brand book. A tile is tomato, yolk, basil, or eggplant — never 'blue' or 'indigo'.

rules.name: The Tinted-Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on a colored tile is the tile's own ink at reduced opacity, never gray.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: Display and tile titles are lowercase; labels are uppercase. No Title Case anywhere.

rules.name: The Cast-Iron Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is #16130e at 100% opacity with zero blur. A soft or colored shadow is a bug.

dos: Do put black text on tomato/yolk/basil and white on eggplant — nothing else pairs.
Do use the dashed border language for anything the user hasn't created yet.
Do keep tiles square and let content overflow to a '+N more' tile rather than scrolling a group.
Do rotate stickers a degree or two; the slight crookedness is the warmth.
donts: Don't use radius, gradients, blur, or soft shadows — the world is flat and hard.
Don't use gray borders or gray-on-color secondary text; borders are cast iron, secondary text is tinted ink.
Don't open a modal for add/rename flows — forms expand inline from dashed tiles.
Don't resurrect rejected worlds: metro-black, pantry-shelf, diner ticket-rail.
